name: container-status-by-label
purpose: Report container names, images, states and exit codes for exited containers matching an exact Docker project label, sorted by name.
procedure: List all matching container IDs with the supplied label filter.
Inspect each ID, strip the leading slash from its name, and include the exit code for exited containers.
Return the rows sorted by name or an empty array if there are no matches.

label.description: Exact Docker project label in key=value form.
